MORAL COMPASS.situation: You are asked whether the ends justify the means.
MORAL COMPASS.question: Can a good outcome justify an unethical action?
MORAL COMPASS.tagalog: Maaari bang bigyang-katwiran ng magandang resulta ang hindi etikal na paraan?
MORAL COMPASS.inspirational: How we achieve something matters alongside what we achieve.
MORAL COMPASS.mensahe: Mahalaga kung paano natin nakamit ang isang bagay, hindi lamang kung ano ang nakamit natin.

MORAL COMPASS.situation: You must choose between personal freedom and responsibility toward others.
MORAL COMPASS.question: How would you balance both?
MORAL COMPASS.tagalog: Paano mo babalansehin ang dalawa?
MORAL COMPASS.inspirational: Freedom becomes meaningful when exercised with responsibility.
MORAL COMPASS.mensahe: Nagiging makabuluhan ang kalayaan kapag ginagamit nang may pananagutan.

MORAL COMPASS.situation: Your conscience tells you to correct an unfair situation even though you are not directly affected.
MORAL COMPASS.question: Would you get involved?
MORAL COMPASS.tagalog: Makikialam ka ba?
MORAL COMPASS.inspirational: Justice is not only about what happens to us; it is also about how we treat others.
MORAL COMPASS.mensahe: Ang katarungan ay hindi lamang tungkol sa nangyayari sa atin kundi sa paraan ng pakikitungo natin sa iba.

MORAL COMPASS.situation: You are unsure whether your choice is motivated by fear or principle.
MORAL COMPASS.question: Would you examine your true motivation before acting?
MORAL COMPASS.tagalog: Susuriin mo ba ang tunay mong motibo bago kumilos?
MORAL COMPASS.inspirational: Self-reflection helps separate principle from fear, pressure, and impulse.
MORAL COMPASS.mensahe: Tinutulungan tayo ng self-reflection na paghiwalayin ang prinsipyo sa takot, pressure, at bugso ng damdamin.

MORAL COMPASS.situation: You must make an important ethical decision with no perfect answer.
MORAL COMPASS.question: What values would guide you?
MORAL COMPASS.tagalog: Anong mga pagpapahalaga ang gagabay sa iyo?
MORAL COMPASS.inspirational: When there is no perfect answer, thoughtful values can guide a responsible choice.
MORAL COMPASS.mensahe: Kapag walang perpektong sagot, maaaring gumabay ang maingat na pagpapahalaga sa responsableng pagpili.

JUSTICE.situation: Two students do very different amounts of work in a group project.
JUSTICE.question: Should they receive exactly the same grade?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang makatanggap ng parehong grado?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness sometimes means considering contribution, not simply treating everyone identically.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Minsan ang pagiging patas ay pagsasaalang-alang sa ambag, hindi lamang pagbibigay ng eksaktong parehong trato.

JUSTICE.situation: A student is excluded from a group because classmates do not like them.
JUSTICE.question: Is personal dislike enough reason to exclude someone?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Sapat bang dahilan ang personal na pagkadismaya upang ibukod ang isang tao?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness asks us to separate personal feelings from another person's right to participate.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hinihingi ng fairness na ihiwalay ang personal na damdamin sa karapatan ng iba na makilahok.

JUSTICE.situation: Your friend breaks a rule, while another student receives punishment for the same behavior.
JUSTICE.question: Should your friend receive the same consequences?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang makatanggap ng parehong kahihinatnan?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness should not depend entirely on who we know.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi dapat nakadepende sa kung sino ang kakilala natin ang pagiging patas.

JUSTICE.situation: A wealthy student and a poor student receive the same punishment for the same action.
JUSTICE.question: Is equal punishment always fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Palagi bang patas ang parehong parusa?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice can involve considering circumstances while maintaining consistent principles.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring isaalang-alang ng katarungan ang sitwasyon habang pinananatili ang mga prinsipyo.

JUSTICE.situation: A student with a disability needs additional time for an exam.
JUSTICE.question: Is giving additional support unfair to other students?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Hindi ba patas sa ibang estudyante ang pagbibigay ng karagdagang suporta?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness can mean providing what people need to participate meaningfully.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring mangahulugan ang fairness ng pagbibigay ng kinakailangan upang makalahok nang maayos ang bawat isa.

JUSTICE.situation: A teacher gives an opportunity only to students who already perform well.
JUSTICE.question: Should struggling students also have a chance?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat din bang bigyan ng pagkakataon ang mga nahihirapang estudyante?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair opportunities can help people develop rather than reward only those who are already successful.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Ang patas na oportunidad ay maaaring makatulong sa pag-unlad, hindi lamang gantimpalaan ang mga matagumpay na.

JUSTICE.situation: Your close friend is responsible for a mistake that affected the whole class.
JUSTICE.question: Should friendship affect how you judge the situation?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang makaapekto ang pagkakaibigan sa iyong paghatol?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice asks us to apply principles consistently.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hinihingi ng katarungan ang pare-parehong paggamit ng prinsipyo.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone is being bullied because they are different from the group.
JUSTICE.question: Should you intervene even if you are not involved?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Makikialam ka ba kahit hindi ka sangkot?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Respect for human dignity does not depend on popularity or similarity.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Ang dignidad ng tao ay hindi nakadepende sa kasikatan o pagkakatulad.

JUSTICE.situation: A group chooses its members based on popularity rather than ability or interest.
JUSTICE.question: Is this fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas ba ito?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair participation means giving people a reasonable opportunity to contribute.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Ang patas na pakikilahok ay pagbibigay sa mga tao ng makatuwirang pagkakataong makapag-ambag.

JUSTICE.situation: You witness someone being treated differently because of their background.
JUSTICE.question: Would you speak up?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Magsasalita ka ba?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice begins with recognizing unfair treatment.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nagsisimula ang katarungan sa pagkilala sa hindi patas na pagtrato.

JUSTICE.situation: Your teacher asks everyone to receive the same grade even though contributions were unequal.
JUSTICE.question: Is equal treatment always the fairest solution?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Ang parehong trato ba ay palaging pinakapatas na solusyon?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Equality and fairness can require careful consideration of circumstances.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring mangailangan ng maingat na pagsasaalang-alang sa sitwasyon ang equality at fairness.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone makes a serious mistake but has never made trouble before.
JUSTICE.question: Should their good record affect the consequences?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang makaapekto ang magandang record nila sa kahihinatnan?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice can consider context while still recognizing responsibility.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring isaalang-alang ng katarungan ang konteksto habang kinikilala ang pananagutan.

JUSTICE.situation: A student repeatedly breaks rules but receives only warnings because they are popular.
JUSTICE.question: Is popularity a fair reason for different treatment?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Makatarungan bang iba ang trato dahil sikat ang isang tao?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness should not be determined by popularity.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi dapat popularity ang batayan ng fairness.

JUSTICE.situation: A student cannot afford expensive materials required for a project.
JUSTICE.question: Should they be judged the same way as students with more resources?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang hatulan nang pareho sa mga estudyanteng mas maraming resources?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness considers whether everyone has a realistic opportunity to meet the same expectations.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Isinasaalang-alang ng fairness kung may tunay na pagkakataon ang lahat na matugunan ang parehong expectations.

JUSTICE.situation: Your group has one limited resource that only one member can use.
JUSTICE.question: How should you decide who gets it?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Paano ninyo pagpapasyahan kung sino ang gagamit nito?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair decisions should use clear and reasonable criteria.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Dapat gumamit ang patas na desisyon ng malinaw at makatuwirang batayan.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone is accused of cheating based only on a rumor.
JUSTICE.question: Should they be punished immediately?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang parusahan agad?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice requires evidence and an opportunity to be heard.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nangangailangan ang katarungan ng ebidensya at pagkakataong marinig ang panig ng isang tao.

JUSTICE.situation: A classmate is accused of something but cannot defend themselves.
JUSTICE.question: Should you hear their side before judging?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat mo bang pakinggan ang kanilang panig bago humusga?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair judgment requires listening to more than one side.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nangangailangan ang patas na paghatol ng pakikinig sa higit sa isang panig.

JUSTICE.situation: A group leader gives their close friends easier tasks.
JUSTICE.question: Is this fair to everyone?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas ba ito sa lahat?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Leadership becomes fair when responsibilities are distributed transparently.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nagiging patas ang leadership kapag malinaw at maayos ang pamamahagi ng responsibilidad.

JUSTICE.situation: You notice that quieter students are rarely given opportunities to speak.
JUSTICE.question: Should you encourage them to participate?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Hihikayatin mo ba silang makilahok?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness includes making room for voices that are often overlooked.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Kasama sa fairness ang pagbibigay ng puwang sa mga boses na madalas hindi napapansin.

JUSTICE.situation: Two people make the same mistake, but only one is punished.
JUSTICE.question: Is that treatment fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas ba ang ganitong pagtrato?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Consistency helps build trust in rules and decisions.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nakakatulong ang consistency upang magkaroon ng tiwala sa mga patakaran at desisyon.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone receives an opportunity because they have a personal connection to the decision-maker.
JUSTICE.question: Is the opportunity fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas ba ang oportunidad?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Opportunities are more trustworthy when decisions are based on fair criteria.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Mas mapagkakatiwalaan ang oportunidad kapag nakabatay ang desisyon sa patas na criteria.

JUSTICE.situation: A classmate is mocked because of their accent.
JUSTICE.question: Would you defend their right to be respected?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Ipagtatanggol mo ba ang kanilang karapatang igalang?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Differences in speech, culture, or background do not reduce human dignity.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi binabawasan ng pagkakaiba sa pananalita, kultura, o background ang dignidad ng tao.

JUSTICE.situation: A student is excluded because they are not considered "cool."
JUSTICE.question: Is social status a fair basis for inclusion?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Makatarungan bang gawing batayan ang social status sa inclusion?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Belonging should not depend solely on popularity.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi dapat nakadepende lamang sa kasikatan ang pagiging kabilang.

JUSTICE.situation: A teacher has limited opportunities and must choose which students receive them.
JUSTICE.question: What criteria should be considered?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Anong criteria ang dapat isaalang-alang?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair decisions become stronger when their criteria are clear and reasonable.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Mas nagiging matibay ang patas na desisyon kapag malinaw at makatuwiran ang batayan.

JUSTICE.situation: Your friend receives special treatment that other students do not receive.
JUSTICE.question: Would you question whether the treatment is fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Tatanungin mo ba kung patas ang ganitong trato?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness sometimes requires us to question advantages we benefit from.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Minsan kailangan nating kuwestiyunin ang mga kalamangan na tayo mismo ang nakikinabang.

JUSTICE.situation: A person who caused harm sincerely wants to make amends.
JUSTICE.question: Should they be given an opportunity to repair the harm?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang bigyan ng pagkakataong itama ang pinsala?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice can include accountability and opportunities for repair.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring kasama sa katarungan ang pananagutan at pagkakataong itama ang pinsala.

JUSTICE.situation: A group punishes everyone because one member broke a rule.
JUSTICE.question: Is collective punishment fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas ba ang collective punishment?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness asks whether consequences are connected to individual responsibility.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Itinatanong ng fairness kung ang parusa ay naaayon sa personal na responsibilidad.

JUSTICE.situation: A student cannot attend an important activity because of a family responsibility.
JUSTICE.question: Should the teacher consider the circumstances?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang isaalang-alang ng guro ang sitwasyon?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness can require understanding circumstances rather than judging only the outcome.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring mangailangan ang fairness ng pag-unawa sa sitwasyon sa halip na tingnan lamang ang resulta.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone receives criticism because of a stereotype about their group.
JUSTICE.question: Should you challenge the assumption?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat mo bang kuwestiyunin ang ganoong palagay?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice requires seeing people as individuals rather than stereotypes.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nangangailangan ang katarungan na tingnan ang tao bilang indibidwal at hindi bilang stereotype.

JUSTICE.situation: Your friend asks you to favor them during a group decision.
JUSTICE.question: Would you treat them differently from everyone else?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Iba ba ang magiging trato mo sa kanila kaysa sa iba?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Friendship should not require abandoning fairness.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi dapat kailanganin ng pagkakaibigan ang pagsuko sa fairness.

JUSTICE.situation: A student who usually performs poorly makes a major contribution.
JUSTICE.question: Would you recognize their contribution?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Kikilalanin mo ba ang kanilang ambag?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness means recognizing effort and contribution without prejudice.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Ang fairness ay pagkilala sa pagsisikap at ambag nang walang prejudice.

JUSTICE.situation: A student who normally performs well makes a mistake.
JUSTICE.question: Should their reputation protect them from accountability?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang protektahan ng kanilang magandang reputasyon?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Accountability should not depend entirely on someone's reputation.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi dapat nakasalalay lamang sa reputasyon ang pananagutan.

JUSTICE.situation: A group has to decide who receives a limited scholarship opportunity.
JUSTICE.question: What would make the selection fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Ano ang magiging patas na batayan sa pagpili?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair selection requires transparent and relevant criteria.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nangangailangan ang patas na pagpili ng malinaw at makabuluhang criteria.

JUSTICE.situation: A person who was previously treated unfairly is now given power over others.
JUSTICE.question: Should they be expected to treat others differently from how they were treated?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang matutong tratuhin nang mas patas ang iba kaysa sa naranasan nila?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Past injustice does not have to determine future behavior.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hindi kailangang diktahan ng nakaraang kawalan ng katarungan ang hinaharap na kilos.

JUSTICE.situation: Your group has to decide whether to give everyone the same reward or reward people according to effort.
JUSTICE.question: Which approach seems fairer to you, and why?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Aling paraan ang mas patas para sa iyo, at bakit?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness can involve thoughtful discussion about equality and contribution.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring mangailangan ang fairness ng maingat na pag-uusap tungkol sa equality at ambag.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone is denied participation because others assume they cannot contribute.
JUSTICE.question: Should they be given a chance to prove themselves?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat ba silang bigyan ng pagkakataong patunayan ang kanilang kakayahan?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness gives people reasonable opportunities rather than deciding their ability in advance.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Ang fairness ay nagbibigay ng makatuwirang pagkakataon sa halip na agad husgahan ang kakayahan.

JUSTICE.situation: A class rule benefits most students but creates a serious problem for a small group.
JUSTICE.question: Should the rule be reconsidered?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang muling suriin ang patakaran?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair systems should remain open to thoughtful review.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Dapat bukas sa maingat na pagsusuri ang patas na sistema.

JUSTICE.situation: You see a classmate being treated unfairly but worry that speaking up will make you unpopular.
JUSTICE.question: Would you speak up?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Magsasalita ka ba?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness can require courage when social pressure is strong.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring mangailangan ng tapang ang fairness kapag malakas ang social pressure.

JUSTICE.situation: A person is judged for their past mistake even after changing.
JUSTICE.question: Should their past permanently define how they are treated?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang permanenteng magtakda ang nakaraan kung paano sila tratuhin?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice can recognize both past accountability and present change.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring kilalanin ng katarungan ang pananagutan sa nakaraan at pagbabago sa kasalukuyan.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone gets a benefit because they know the right person.
JUSTICE.question: Is personal connection a fair basis for opportunity?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas bang gawing batayan ng oportunidad ang personal na koneksyon?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair opportunities should be based on relevant and transparent reasons.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Dapat nakabatay ang patas na oportunidad sa makabuluhan at malinaw na dahilan.

JUSTICE.situation: Your friend is wrongly accused and you know information that could help.
JUSTICE.question: Would you speak up?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Magsasalita ka ba?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice benefits when people are willing to provide relevant truth.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nakikinabang ang katarungan kapag handang magsabi ng mahalagang katotohanan ang mga tao.

JUSTICE.situation: You are asked to choose between helping a friend and helping someone who has a greater need.
JUSTICE.question: Should friendship determine who receives help?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang friendship ang magtakda kung sino ang tutulungan?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness asks us to consider need, not only personal connection.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Hinihingi ng fairness na isaalang-alang ang pangangailangan, hindi lamang personal na koneksyon.

JUSTICE.situation: A student is punished more severely because they are unpopular.
JUSTICE.question: Is this fair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Patas ba ito?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice requires consistent standards regardless of popularity.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nangangailangan ang justice ng pare-parehong standards anuman ang popularity.

JUSTICE.situation: A student receives an opportunity because they have demonstrated exceptional effort.
JUSTICE.question: Is giving them the opportunity unfair to others?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Hindi ba patas sa iba ang pagbibigay sa kanila ng oportunidad?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness can recognize meaningful effort when the criteria are clear.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring kilalanin ng fairness ang makabuluhang pagsisikap kapag malinaw ang batayan.

JUSTICE.situation: You notice that some students are always chosen first while others are never considered.
JUSTICE.question: Would you suggest a fairer selection process?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Magmumungkahi ka ba ng mas patas na proseso ng pagpili?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fair systems should create reasonable opportunities for everyone.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Dapat lumikha ang patas na sistema ng makatuwirang oportunidad para sa lahat.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone is excluded because of a stereotype about their abilities.
JUSTICE.question: Would you challenge the stereotype?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Hahamunin mo ba ang stereotype?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness begins when we question assumptions that limit people.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nagsisimula ang fairness kapag kinukuwestiyon natin ang mga palagay na naglilimita sa iba.

JUSTICE.situation: You realize that your own group has treated another group unfairly.
JUSTICE.question: Would you acknowledge it?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Aaminin mo ba ito?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice requires honesty even when the truth reflects poorly on our own group.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Nangangailangan ang justice ng katapatan kahit hindi maganda ang ipinapakita ng katotohanan tungkol sa ating grupo.

JUSTICE.situation: A rule was created long ago but no longer seems fair to everyone.
JUSTICE.question: Should old rules always remain unchanged?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Dapat bang manatiling pareho ang mga lumang patakaran?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Fairness can require reviewing rules as circumstances change.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Maaaring mangailangan ang fairness ng pagsusuri sa mga patakaran habang nagbabago ang sitwasyon.

JUSTICE.situation: Someone receives more support because they need it more.
JUSTICE.question: Is unequal support necessarily unfair?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Ang hindi pantay na suporta ba ay awtomatikong hindi patas?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Treating people fairly does not always mean giving everyone exactly the same thing.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Ang patas na pagtrato ay hindi laging nangangahulugang eksaktong pareho ang ibinibigay sa lahat.

JUSTICE.situation: You have to decide what fairness means in a difficult situation.
JUSTICE.question: Would you consider equality, need, effort, and consequences before deciding?
JUSTICE.tagalog: Isasaalang-alang mo ba ang equality, pangangailangan, effort, at consequences bago magdesisyon?
JUSTICE.inspirational: Justice becomes stronger when decisions consider more than one perspective.
JUSTICE.mensahe: Mas nagiging matibay ang justice kapag higit sa isang pananaw ang isinasaalang-alang.
